visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: max-height instead of a fixed height
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The box has a fixed height, so it leaves empty space when it has little content. Use max-height so it only grows as far as needed. With long content it must still stop at 80px.

solution.explanation: max-height lets the box be as small as its content and stops it at the limit. A fixed height wastes space for short content and still needs overflow for long content.
